manifest.title: Firebase
manifest.description: Firebase Hosting + Authentication + Firestore + Cloud Functions, with separate dev and production projects.

spec.title: Write the spec
spec.description: Fills in the spec templates for the base and the use case from the answers to the questions. Anything not yet decided goes on a list.

prerequisites.title: Tools and sign-in
prerequisites.description: Installs the CLIs and signs in to Firebase and Google Cloud.

projects.title: Development and production projects
projects.description: Sets up two Firebase projects and puts them on the pay-as-you-go (Blaze) plan.

scaffold.title: App skeleton
scaffold.description: Creates the screens, Cloud Functions, the emulator settings and the starting point for testing the rules.

auth.title: Sign-in
auth.description: Adds sign-in with Google and checks it with the Auth emulator.

data-rules.title: Data shape and security rules
data-rules.description: Creates the collections in the spec and opens them one at a time in firestore.rules. Everything else is refused.

deploy-dev.title: Publish for development
deploy-dev.description: Publishes the rules, functions and screens to the development project.

protect.title: App Check and a budget alert
protect.description: Turns on App Check and sets a budget alert on the production project.

security.title: Security check
security.description: Before publishing to production, reads what was built the way an attacker would, following OWASP Top 10:2025, fixes the holes that can be exploited, confirms the fixes with emulator tests, and writes a report. The fixes are published to development again, to check that the screens still work.

deploy-production.title: Publish to production
deploy-production.description: Publishes to production the same build that was checked in development.
